text:
Maya: Quick idea  run a micro-seed experiment tying free credits -> prompt packs -> a short webinar. Goal: increase signup->3-queries conversion within 48h by ~10%. Thoughts?

Jon: Sounds good. Proposed cohort size?

Maya: 400 total signups seeded, split A/B. Use 8 niche dev influencers. Each referral link gives 100 starter credits + access to a prompt pack.

Priya: We'll surface two template packs: 'hackathon-starter' and 'sales-cold-email'. Short social copy ready: `100 free credits + prompt templates. Join our 30-min workshop.`

Diego: Metric note  baseline conversion ~20%. With credits + templates expect ~28% (rough). That nets ~32 extra actives for 400 signups.

Lina: Routing: seed cohort should skip the long product tour and land on a templates modal with CTA "Run sample". Also enqueue a 24h email nudge and a 48h in-app push.

Maya: A/B plan: A gets webinar invite + credits + templates; B gets credits + templates only. Isolate webinar effect.

Jon: Growth ops ask: can we add utm and `seed_cohort` metadata on signup?

Diego: Yes. Use ?utm_source=influencerName and set signup metadata seed_cohort=influencerName. I'll add dashboards for cohort funnels.

Priya: Webinar invite copy (short): "Build with Redwood: 30-min hands-on prompt workshop + credits". CTA: "Bring a prompt  we'll optimize live."

Maya: Timeline: influencer posts Tue 11AM PT, routing + credits live Tue 9AM PT, webinar Wed 5PM PT. Need landing + gating by Mon EOD.

Lina: Gating plan: require email verification before claim to reduce spam. Flow: email -> verify -> claim credits. Product sets onboarding_variant=A|B.

Jon: Cost check: 400 * 100 credits = 40k credits. Estimated token spend first 48h ~150-250 tokens/user/day. Cost: modest (low hundreds USD).

Priya: Example prompt pack snippets (will push to drive):
- hackathon-starter: "Generate a minimal prompt chain to extract meeting notes from audio."
- sales-cold-email: "Shorten and personalize this cold email for Head of Product."

Maya: Action items: Priya (social + templates), Diego (analytics + dashboards), Lina (routing + gating), Jon (influencer coordination), deploy-bot (schedule webinar). Check-in tomorrow 9:30AM PT.

deploy-bot: Created event 'Micro-seed activation workshop' Wed 17:00 PT  invites sent to #marketing.

Jon: Recommend small public shoutouts for influencers to encourage follow-ups.

Priya: I'll make a referral card they can share.

Maya: Optional: test credit sizing? maybe test 100 vs 200 credits on a tiny subsplit. Diego: small n might be noisy but could show directionality; okay to run ~50 users at 200 credits.

Lina: Ops: rollback plan  if we see spammy behavior pause credit issuance and require manual whitelist.

Maya: Great. I'll finalize influencer list and update the launch doc. Links will be posted in thread.
